checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Same framing, trees, mountains, logs and reflections; very faithful to the photo.
Clouds move and change across frames, but they morph, break up and re-form, so it is more evolving than drifting.

must.item: Gentle ripples on lake, not rough
must.why: Reflections shift and the surface gains soft ripple texture, with no surf. Reflections change a lot, though.
Mountains, tree line and foreground pines look fixed across frames. Alpenglow on the peaks fades.

must.item: Camera stationary and evening lighting consistent
must.why: The camera is static, but the light darkens and the peak alpenglow fades from 0.8 s to 7.6 s, so the lighting is not fully consistent.
826x496 is about 5:3 and the clip is 8 s. Silence is not verifiable but is stated.

faults.what: The lighting drifts from warm to cooler and darker. Alpenglow on the peaks and the pink in the clouds fade.
The clouds morph, fragment and change shape and brightness rather than drifting as a unit.
The reflections change noticeably in brightness and shape, which is more than gentle ripples.

summary: A faithful, static-camera lake clip with moving clouds and rippling reflections and fixed mountains and trees. The clouds morph and the evening glow fades somewhat over the 8 seconds.
